title: Fibre bundles and the medium Whitney embedding theorem
summary: Locally trivial fibre bundles with fibre F (Definition 14.2) and examples; Whitney's embedding theorem in the medium version (Theorem 15.1): using Sard's theorem to project a compact n-manifold embedded in R^N down to R^{2n+1}.
